content.thinking: Early numbers show the Valentine's post leading with 5 streams for $5.53 spent, while post 1 has 1 stream ($3.05) and post 3 has 0 ($2.54). Still too little data to act on, so I'll check back in 6 hours.

At the 12h mark, $21.25 has been spent across 9 streams, with Valentine's post leading (5 streams, $10.61) followed by Post 1 and Post 3. Cost per stream is too close across posts to declare a winner, so I'll leave the campaign as is.

The Valentine's post is outperforming at $1.09/stream vs. $2.97 and $3.69 for the other two, so I'm reallocating budget: Valentine's ad group up to $60 total ($35/day), evergreen group down to $40 total ($12/day), keeping the $100 total intact.

Spend check: $64.53 of $100 used, with the Valentine's post performing best at $1.18/stream vs $1.94/stream for the other two. I shifted the budget caps (Valentine's $40→$60, others $60→$40) since it stops at midnight Auckland time while the others run through Monday.

The Valentine's ad group has ended (49 streams at $1.16 each vs. evergreen's 15 streams at $1.88 each), confirming the budget shift was right. I'm now pausing the finished Valentine's ad group and raising the evergreen cap to $43 to keep total spend under $100.

The Valentine's ad group's spend ticked up to $58.35 from late billing, which would push the combined total with the $43 evergreen cap to around $101. I'll lower the evergreen cap now to stay safely under $100.

content.text:
Your Valentine's push ran Saturday 13 to Monday 15 February (Auckland time) and has finished. I've paused the campaign as well, so nothing else can spend.

**Recap**
- **Spend:** $98.41 of your $100.00 budget
- **Impressions:** 179,009
- **Link clicks:** 186
- **Album streams** (your "Album stream" pixel)**:** 83, which works out to about $1.19 per stream

**Results by ad group**

| Ad group | Ran | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Streams | Cost per stream |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valentine's post | Sat–Sun | $58.35 | 100,879 | 124 | 52 | $1.12 |
| "New album" + "12 songs, 34 minutes" posts | Sat–Mon | $40.07 | 78,130 | 62 | 31 | $1.29 |

**What I did along the way**
- **Setup:** I used only your three approved posts and set every ad group to aim for as many "Album stream" pixel events as possible. Both ad groups targeted parents and families aged 25–54 everywhere except Russia and Belarus.
- **Budget shift:** On Saturday afternoon the Valentine's post was bringing in streams at about a third of the cost of the other two. "12 songs, 34 minutes" was the weakest of the three. I moved budget towards the Valentine's post: $60 for it and $40 for the other two.
- **After Valentine's Day:** At the end of Sunday I stopped the Valentine's post, because its "Valentine's Day is Sunday" wording would be out of date. The other ad group ran on through Monday. I adjusted its limit so total spend stayed under $100.

**One mistake on my part:** both ad groups only showed ads to people who use X in English. Your album page, landing page and posts are available in every major language, so that cut out most of the world. Next time, I'd drop the language filter and let each market see its own language version, which should reach far more people for the same money.
